![Who Hates Frag Plugs? - ReefBum](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/04282126-1032-0139-0000-40179c61b2a5:28)
Frag plugs are `small, typically ceramic or aragonite bases used in reef tanks to hold coral fragments (frags) while they grow and attach, making it easier to propagate, arrange, or sell corals` . They often feature a stem for insertion into frag racks and are designed to blend into reef rockwork. Common materials include inert, high-temperature fired ceramics for stability.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oE9RzzhGwO4#:~:text=A%20frag%20plug%20is%20a%20base%20used,LPS%2C%20encrusting%20corals%2C%20or%20a%20natural%20look.)[[2]](https://www.amazon.com/Frag-Plugs-Disks-Awesome-Aquatic/dp/B0BMTLB8ND)[[3]](https://fragbox.ca/product-category/dry/fragging/frag-plugs/#:~:text=Frag%20plugs%20are%20used%20to%20make%20frags,Frag%20Saver%20%E2%80%93%20Ceramic%20Frag%20Plug%20Holder)[[4]](https://www.reefcreators.com/1000-Ceramic-Frag-Plugs_p_15.html)[[5]](https://www.aliexpress.com/s/wiki-ssr/article/frag-plug#:~:text=Frag%20plugs%20offer%20a%20durable%2C%20porous%20alternative,support%20successful%20coral%20propagation%20over%20extended%20periods.)

This video explains the different types of frag plugs available:![Related video thumbnail](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/04282126-1032-0139-0000-40179c61b2a5:29)
1m[![](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/04282126-1032-0139-0000-40179c61b2a5:30)
![](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/04282126-1032-0139-0000-40179c61b2a5:31)
BRStv - Saltwater Aquariums & Reef Tanks YouTube• Jul 2, 2021](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oE9RzzhGwO4&t=321) 

**Key Features and Types** 

- **Materials:** Primarily ceramic, aragonite, or concrete-based (Agrocrete).
- **Shapes:** Standard plugs with stems (typically 2 4 m m−1 i n c h ) are common for rack insertion. Flat discs and frag rocks/rubble are used for a more natural look.
- **Colors:** Available in white, purple (to simulate coralline algae), and black.
- **Porosity:** Many are porous to encourage faster coral adhesion and bacterial growth.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ic6XT7wvlws&t=4)[[2]](https://www.bulkreefsupply.com/saltwater-aquarium-fragging-supplies/frag-plugs-disks.html)[[3]](https://www.saltwateraquarium.com/specialty/fragging/frag-plugs/)[[4]](https://www.amazon.com/Frag-Plugs-Disks-Awesome-Aquatic/dp/B0BMTLB8ND)[[5]](https://fragbox.ca/product-category/dry/fragging/frag-plugs/#:~:text=Frag%20plugs%20are%20used%20to%20make%20frags,Frag%20Saver%20%E2%80%93%20Ceramic%20Frag%20Plug%20Holder)[[6]](https://www.coralvue.com/1in-biological-frag-plugs-with-flat-top)

This video shows how to make your own frag plugs:![Related video thumbnail](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/04282126-1032-0139-0000-40179c61b2a5:32)
57s[![](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/04282126-1032-0139-0000-40179c61b2a5:33)
![](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/04282126-1032-0139-0000-40179c61b2a5:34)
Niagara Fire Corals YouTube• Jul 5, 2025](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V1PhT4j9Ar8&t=237) **Common Uses** 

- **Fragging:** Used to propagate SPS (Small Polyp Stony), LPS (Large Polyp Stony), and soft corals.
- **Stability:** Provides a solid, stable base for frags, preventing them from blowing away in tank currents.
- **Marketplace:** Used for selling or trading corals, with options like [[Ocean Wonders Ceramic Frag Plugs](https://www.google.com/search?q=Ocean+Wonders+Ceramic+Frag+Plugs&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjXuNOBlpGUAxWeIEQIHcILF3cQgK4QegYIAQgCEA8) ](https://www.bulkreefsupply.com/saltwater-aquarium-fragging-supplies/frag-plugs-disks.html) and [Maxspect Nano-Tech Bio-Plugs](https://www.google.com/search?q=Maxspect+Nano-Tech+Bio-Plugs&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjXuNOBlpGUAxWeIEQIHcILF3cQgK4QegYIAQgCEBA) popular in the industry.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ic6XT7wvlws&t=4)[[2]](https://www.amazon.com/Frag-Plugs-Disks-Awesome-Aquatic/dp/B0BMTLB8ND)[[3]](https://www.bulkreefsupply.com/saltwater-aquarium-fragging-supplies/frag-plugs-disks.html)

This video demonstrates how to mount corals on new frag plugs:![Related video thumbnail](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/04282126-1032-0139-0000-40179c61b2a5:35)
1m[![](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/04282126-1032-0139-0000-40179c61b2a5:36)
![](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/04282126-1032-0139-0000-40179c61b2a5:37)
SeaTee Aquatics YouTube• Apr 5, 2024](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5EBmcjDSJTs&t=88) **Top Considerations** 

- **Curing:** Some cement-based plugs may require curing to avoid pH spikes, while most ceramic options from brands like [ReefCreators](https://www.google.com/search?q=ReefCreators&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjXuNOBlpGUAxWeIEQIHcILF3cQgK4QegYIAQgCEB8) are inert and safe for immediate use.
- **Algae Management:** Darker colored or purple plugs are often preferred to reduce the visual impact of algae growth compared to bright white plugs.
- **Size:** Standard 1-i n c h plugs fit most standard eggcrate rack systems.[[1]](https://www.bulkreefsupply.com/saltwater-aquarium-fragging-supplies/frag-plugs-disks.html)[[2]](https://www.reefcreators.com/1000-Ceramic-Frag-Plugs_p_15.html)[[3]](https://www.bulkreefsupply.com/content/post/brstv-buyers-guide-to-frag-plugs#:~:text=As%20noted%20above%2C%20dark%20frag%20plugs%20will,of%20algae%20when%20compared%20to%20light-colored%20plugs.)[[4]](https://www.ubuy.com.jm/product/1R3H6JNQ-reefing-art-ceramic-coralline-purple-coral-frag-plugs-30-pack-tiles-for-sps-lps#:~:text=Question:%20What%20sizes%20are%20the%20ceramic%20frag,while%20fitting%20conveniently%20into%20standard%20frag%20racks.)[[5]](https://www.kosovo.ubuy.com/en/product/871JKBTQ6-ceramic-coral-frag-plugs-disks-base-with-free-reef-glue-gel-awesome-aquatic-frag-plug-frag-plate-frag-disc-10-pack-24-mm-w-glue#:~:text=Standard%20plugs%20easily%20fit%20in%20various%20setups%20%28eggcrate%2C%20racks%2C%20live%20rock%29.)
